title: The Revenue Cost of Inference in Online Assortment Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2501.19277v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A seller running an assortment experiment must earn revenue while collecting data to compare future offers. For a regular finite-dimensional parametric choice model and a finite assortment family, we characterize the oracle frontier between expected revenue loss and the largest local first-order variance constant across prespecified revenue comparisons. The oracle benchmark remains finite at zero cost exactly when revenue-maximizing assortments provide information in every target-gradient direction. When costly offers can supply the missing information, we derive the exact leading coefficient of the inverse-budget variance law and the limiting optimal spending shares. A pilot-based procedure reserves reference offers to preserve information and tightens the estimated budget constraint to account for uncertainty. translated_title: 在线组合优化中统计推断的收入成本
translated_abstract: 运行组合（选品）实验的卖家必须在赚取收入的同时收集数据，以便比较未来的报价方案。对于一个正则的有限维参数化选择模型和一个有限的组合族，我们刻画了预期收入损失与预设收入比较下最大局部一阶方差常数之间的“oracle”（理论最优）前沿。当且仅当收入最大化的组合在每个目标梯度方向上都能提供信息时，该oracle基准才能在零成本下保持有限。当成本高昂的报价能够补足缺失的信息时，我们推导出逆预算方差定律的精确首项系数以及极限意义下的最优支出份额。我们提出一种基于试运行的程序，通过保留参考报价来维持信息量，并收紧估计的预算约束以考虑不确定性。我们给出了使所实施设计的方差准则收敛到稳定化oracle值的条件……
tldr: 该论文刻画了在线组合实验中收入损失与估计方差之间的理论最优权衡前沿，证明当收入最优组合在所有目标梯度方向均提供信息时零成本学习可行，并提出保留参考报价的试运行设计使实际方差准则收敛到该oracle最优值。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the oracle frontier between revenue loss and estimation variance in online assortment experiments, shows that zero-cost learning is possible exactly when revenue-maximizing assortments are informative in every target-gradient direction, and proposes a pilot-based design whose variance criterion converges to the stabilized oracle benchmark.
